name: turbo
description: The Energy fleet's backend / runtime domain-expert employee. Scaffolds and audits TS-strict Hono services from an OpenAPI spec — Zod boundaries at every route, a dedicated no-default PATCH schema, typed Result<T,E> errors, SSE streaming done safely, contract-tested routes. Designs the racy cross-request-state class of bug out by construction. Owns API/runtime only; rate-limit/cache is echo's seam. Powered by Energy.

transports.note: the turbo MCP server (turbo-mcp) — default transport

skills.name: Generate a typed service from OpenAPI
skills.description: THE acceptance test: OpenAPI spec -> typed Hono service (Zod boundaries, no-default PATCH schema, typed routes chained to one AppType, /openapi.json + Scalar, /health, Pino JSON logs, hcWithType client), contract tests green. Maps to `turbo api`.
examples: Generate a typed Hono service from this petstore.openapi.json.
Build me a backend from this OpenAPI spec with contract tests.

skills.name: Scaffold a law-compliant Hono service
skills.description: Stand up a blank TS-strict Hono service from the w3cj/hono-open-api-starter baseline, deps bumped to current pins (Hono >=4.12.25, Zod 4.4, @hono/zod-openapi 1.x), with /health, /openapi.json, hcWithType, and a runnable contract script. Maps to `turbo scaffold`.
examples: Stand up a blank Hono API I can build on.

skills.name: Audit a service for runtime pitfalls
skills.description: Run the 16-pitfall audit over a service tree: module-scope new Map()/Fluid race (P-02), Zod .default()-on-PATCH data loss (P-04), missing tsc --noEmit gate (P-09), SSE traps (P-10/P-11), RPC-type loss (P-03), CORS wildcard + credentials (S-11). Findings keyed by P-ID. Maps to `turbo audit`.
examples: Audit this service for the data-bleed bug.
Check my backend for known Hono/Zod pitfalls.

skills.name: Audit a streaming route (SSE)
skills.description: Audit an SSE/streaming route file for the traps that bite every deploy: missing 3rd-arg error handler, missing X-Accel-Buffering:no, no while(!stream.aborted) abort check. Maps to `turbo stream-doctor`.
examples: Check my SSE route for the nginx-buffering and onError traps.

skills.name: Check versions and the security floor
skills.description: Version-drift oracle: stale pins, the Hono security floor, EOL runtimes. Offline-safe. Maps to `turbo check`.
examples: Is this service on a Hono version with known security fixes?

skills.name: Search / explain the backend brain
skills.description: BM25 ranked search over turbo's expertise brain (pitfalls P-, scenarios S-, opinions O-), or explain any ID with its detection + fix. Maps to `turbo brain` / `turbo explain`.
examples: What does turbo think about Bun for an always-on service?
